events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $7.26 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
The trip is RydeTAXI, so the metered fare moves with distance and any unexcused extra kilometre is money the rider should not have paid [F6][RD-2]. The complete chat record holds only two messages — the rider's pickup note and the driver's arrival note — both about the pick-up point, with no discussion of any route [F7][F8][F9]. Nothing in it names a road, an area or a stop the rider asked for.

I therefore read F3 (off-route 12:12–12:22, 6.47 km driven against 1.32 km optimal, +5.15 km) as an unexcused deviation [F3][RD-1]. The driver's claim that his GPS rerouted him is only his post-trip statement, not consent recorded before the segment, and a mere GPS reroute is not a "reasonable cause" under the policy [F10][RD-5].

The traffic facts do not excuse it either: the only records near the route are speed bands 4 and 5 — moderate flow, not the band 1–2 severe congestion the policy contemplates — and no incident was logged on the replaced stretch, so the RD-4 screen fails [F11][F12][F13][RD-4]. RD-3 does not apply because no rider-named stop exists in the record; the rider named only the pick-up entrance, not a place on this segment [F7][RD-3].

Amount: the segment added 5.15 km, and the metered distance rate is $20.43 ÷ 14.5 km = $1.4090/km [F3][F6]. 5.15 km × $1.4090/km = $7.2563, which rounds to $7.26 [F4][RD-2]. (The $8.35 excess-distance line covers all 5.9 km of the trip's overrun; only the 5.15 km attributable to the unexcused segment is refundable, per RD-2's limit to the segment and its ≤0.25 km matching residue exclusion.) Wait time is billed per the meter under RD-3(c) and is not refunded, and platform fee and base fare are unaffected [F6][RD-2].

Because a non-exempt segment is found (RD-2 refund > 0) and the driver profile shows 2 upheld route disputes in the last 90 days, the case is a repeated breach and the account flag attaches [F16][RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked at your RydeTAXI trip and found that part of the distance you were charged for wasn't justified. The driver took a detour of about 5 kilometres on a stretch we couldn't excuse — you never asked for that route, there was no serious traffic to explain it, and a re-route from a navigation app after the fact isn't a valid reason.

As a result, we're refunding $7.26 to you as a Ryde voucher. Your base fare, platform fee and wait time are unchanged.

No action is needed from you — the voucher will be issued to your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed a route dispute on one of your RydeTAXI trips. About 5 kilometres of off-route driving on a stretch of that trip was not excused: the rider asked for no route or stop there, the traffic records don't show conditions that would justify it, and a navigation-app re-route raised after the trip isn't accepted as a reason.

The rider is being refunded $7.26 as a Ryde voucher, and this breach is recorded on your account. Because you have upheld route disputes from the last 90 days, your account is being sent for review.

You don't need to do anything right now, but keep to the rider's requested route on future trips.
